shares_diluted.basis: ttm_shares_diluted = ytd_current (weighted average diluted shares for the current YTD period)

overrides_used.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25, accession 0002074176-26-000010), Consolidated Statements of Changes in Stockholders' Equity (pp. 51-52), row 'Equity-based compensation' credited to additional paid-in capital: $7M for FY2025, with $3M for FY2024 and $1M for FY2023 in the same statement. The cash-flow statement (p. 50) carries no separate equity-compensation addback line — it is inside the 'Other' operating adjustment of $13M / $6M / $3M — which is why EDGAR companyfacts has no ShareBasedCompensation fact for this filer.

Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25, accession 0002074176-26-000010), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. 50): the investing-activities section for 2025/2024/2023 lists ONLY 'Acquisitions of oil and natural gas interests' $(1,549)M / $(696)M / $(830)M, 'Acquisitions of oil and natural gas interests—related party' $(875)M / $— / $(75)M and 'Proceeds from sale of oil and natural gas interests' $— / $88M / $(3)M, netting to $(2,424)M / $(608)M / $(908)M. There is no purchases-of-property-plant-and-equipment, fixed-asset or capital-expenditure line anywhere in the statement for any of the three years (the balance sheet carries only $8M of other property, equipment and land at FY2025).
